link-studio on Omarchy

A native Linux control panel for your Insta360 Link webcam.

Short answer

To install link-studio on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add link-studio. It is a 3.8 MB download (5.3 MB installed), version 1.0.4-1, licensed MIT. Native Linux controller for Insta360 Link webcams. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install link-studio on Omarchy

Link Studio is an open-source, unofficial Linux app for controlling Insta360 Link webcams, filling the gap left by Insta360's Windows/macOS-only software. It gives direct access to the camera's pan, tilt, zoom, autofocus, and privacy-mode controls, plus its built-in AI tracking modes (like Whiteboard and DeskView), alongside live preview, H.264 recording, and local effects such as background blur and green screen. It's built with GTK4 and libadwaita, so it follows your desktop's light/dark theme, and it can also act as a virtual camera and offer optional offline transcription of voice notes.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add link-studio
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.0.4-1:
    pacman -Qi link-studio

Open and use link-studio

link-studio is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql link-studio | grep applications

link-studio requirements and compatibility

  • An Insta360 Link or Link 2 webcam (hardware-tested with Link 2)
  • GTK4, libadwaita, V4L2/UVC, GStreamer, PipeWire, OpenCV and MediaPipe on the system

Frequently asked questions

How do I install link-studio on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add link-studio. The download is 3.8 MB and it takes 5.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is link-studio free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall link-studio?

Run omarchy pkg drop link-studio. It removes the package from your system.

What does link-studio depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: gst-libav, gst-plugins-bad, gst-plugins-base, gst-plugins-good, gtk4, libadwaita, python-gobject, python-mediapipe, python-numpy, python-opencv, python-pillow, python-qrcode and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is link-studio a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for link-studio.

Is link-studio in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as link-studio (version 1.0.4-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Jake makes it. Project site: https://jweaver60.github.io/link-studio/.
